general_reuse: Campaigns cite this registry by path and source_ids rather than retyping source claims.
Adapters consume source capability/claim metadata before downloading or sampling large datasets.
Phoenix/Lupine Science reports show claim level and guardrail next to any sourced evidence.
registry: Every source has source_id, title, source_kind, URL records, citation metadata, license, stewardship, capabilities, claim_support, verification, and ingestion fields.
Every claim_support entry has a claim_id, known claim level, evidence fields, and guardrail.
A source cannot support phase_label_reference unless its capabilities.phase_label is truthy.
A ready_for_sampler source must have at least one verified live or verified local check.
state_phase_seed_v1: At least one source supports state_condition_coverage.
At least one distinct source supports phase_change_labels or phase_label_reference.
Every imported row preserves source_id, citation_key, license note, original id, and source-specific provenance fields.
State-condition labels and phase labels remain separate fields until an evaluator explicitly joins them.
